_comment: Per-object realistic augmentation ranges. scaleMin/scaleMax bound the per-env uniform object scale; massExp is the mass model (2=hollow shell -> a +-15% size is ~+-30% mass; 3=solid; 1=rod/thin-frame). The loader (intermimic.py objectAug block) REQUIRES an entry for every object present in the training set and fails loudly listing any that are missing -- add cluster objects here rather than letting them default silently. Bigger/heavier furniture is scaled tighter. Review these before a real run; they are reasonable starting values, not measured.
